title: Top Wallets: Slim, Leather & RFID (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selections were based on products mentioned in multiple sources (CNET and Gear43) and their stated features.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.

verdict.line: Picture a commuter who wants a sleek, low‑profile wallet that holds up to eight cards and has a built‑in ejector mechanism. The Ekster Cardholder Pro delivers that with an elegant design, a lifetime warranty, and a metal ejector that makes card access quick. Its main catch is that it is larger than some competitors.
